title: Phase 1: Control Catalog
goal: Know what must be proven, by whom, and when it expires.

title: Phase 2: Collection
goal: Fan the requests out and record what comes back, unaltered.

title: Phase 3: Attestation and Decision
goal: Attest, countersign, and decide whether each piece of evidence is sufficient.

title: Phase 4: Findings
goal: Track every finding to an owner and a date; log every pass.
unlocks: A register the package can report.

title: Phase 5: Package and Retention
goal: Assemble the package, keep it on schedule, and let expiries drive next quarter.
unlocks: The quarterly package and next quarter's calendar.
